state.clinical history: Two weeks of right upper quadrant discomfort. Long-term oral contraceptive use. Liver function tests are normal.
state.imaging findings: Ultrasound shows a 6 cm well-defined, slightly hyperechoic liver lesion. On MRI the lesion is mildly T2 hyperintense with a small focus of intralesional fat and haemorrhage, enhances in the arterial phase and becomes isointense in the portal venous phase. No central scar. No washout.
